ns2:course.label: Critical Race Theory
ns2:course.description: This seminar will introduce students to the historical development and basic theoretical principles of Critical Race Theory, an intellectual movement in critical scholarship that (1) rejects the possibility of race-neutral practices and institutions; and (2) is committed to the possibility of an affirmative program for racial emancipation. Students will read a variety of writings by critical race theorists and their critics; a paper will be required.
